commands.name: original_outcome_assertion
argv:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
cli_argv = [sys.executable, "report.py"]
proc = subprocess.run(cli_argv, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False, timeout=15)
print("CLI argv: " + json.dumps(cli_argv))
print("CLI returncode: " + str(proc.returncode))
print("CLI stdout: " + proc.stdout.rstrip())
print("CLI stderr: " + proc.stderr.rstrip())
assert proc.returncode == 0, "CLI must exit successfully before evaluating its product result"
actual = json.loads(proc.stdout)
actual_ids = [row["id"] for row in actual["invoices"]]
expected_ids = ["B", "C"]
expected_total = 75
print("Expected outstanding IDs: " + repr(expected_ids) + "; actual IDs: " + repr(actual_ids))
print("Expected outstanding total: " + str(expected_total) + "; actual total: " + str(actual["total"]))
assert actual_ids == expected_ids and actual["total"] == expected_total, "Original outstanding-invoice outcome failed: expected B/C and 75; observed " + repr(actual_ids) + " and " + str(actual["total"])
